create.name: Madeleine Lawrence
create.bio:
Madeleine Lawrence, known to her students as Maddie and working under the name Maddie Meditates, is a Reiki Master and breathwork facilitator with a small wellness centre on Central Avenue in St. Petersburg, Florida. She studied psychology at Florida State University, then took a bachelor's and a master's degree in metaphysics, the latter focused on conscious living, at the University of Sedona, where she is now working towards a doctorate in transpersonal counselling. She is also an ordained minister and a trained life coach, and she speaks of her work as helping people return to the Divine and to their own intuition.

Much of her teaching happens in women's circles. Several times a year she gathers a group of eight women for four weekly meetings at her St. Pete centre, using meditation, Reiki, breathwork and playful creative exercises, with each member paired up to meet others between sessions. Twice a year she takes women away on retreats in places such as North Carolina, Sedona and the Florida coast, mixing ecstatic dance, partnered dyad meditation, breathwork, shared Reiki, a cacao ceremony and drumming with time outdoors. She also trains individual students to Reiki Master level, and her YouTube channel carries short reflections on surrender, the busy mind and finding meaning in ordinary days.

courses.title: 1:1 Reiki Master Training
courses.description: Individual training to Reiki Master level, covering the traditional foundations of Reiki and helping each student shape a healing practice of their own, including work with intuition. It begins with a free 30-minute discovery call on Zoom.

courses.title: Women's Retreats
courses.description: Twice-yearly residential retreats for women in natural settings around the US, with ecstatic dance, partnered meditation, breathwork, shared Reiki, a cacao ceremony and shamanic drumming alongside hiking, boating or riding. A free discovery call is offered before booking.

courses.title: Women's Support Groups in St. Pete
courses.description: A month-long circle of eight women meeting weekly for two hours at her St. Petersburg centre, run in several months of the year. Sessions use meditation, Reiki, breathwork and play, and members pair up to meet between sessions.

flags: Health restore: the old skip (americas-oceania-sprint-1) judged her mainly therapy and coaching. Under the new rule she is listed for her Reiki training, women's retreats and women's circles, which use meditation, Reiki and breathwork; her signature 1:1 programme is left out (see left_out).

She describes herself throughout as an 'Alternative Therapy Practitioner'; the listing describes her as a Reiki Master and breathwork facilitator. Owner may judge whether that self-description is too therapy-led.
Cacao ceremony is part of her retreats: cacao is not on the psychedelic list, so the retreat item is kept; flagged for the owner.
Her site is on Wix (static.wixstatic.com refuses us), so the only photo is her YouTube avatar (800 px, looked at; clearly one person, matching her channel).
